Thanks @lebaphi - could you provide stories that show how the more-info is added to a block of text or an icon.

I'm _hoping_ our implementation means we can have something like this:
```
<MoreInfo description="The percentage fuel remaining">Fuel</MoreInfo>

<MoreInfo description="Whether this player can edit this commodity">
  <FontAwesomeIcon icon='fa-user-cog'/>
</MoreInfo>
```

I think the _current_ implementation means the the icon is declared immediately after the text/icon it relates to.  But, I want it to "steal" some of the area from the text/icon it relates to - to "tie" them together.    If that's possible by declaring it afterwards, then that's ok.

One last thing. Could the cursor please change to a question mark (or info marker) as it goes over the icon please?

Great progress.  But,  the "i" icon is missing in StoryBook: 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/153761013-c86d10f7-0230-4ec9-8a81-0aada16dce60.png)

It;s the "i" icon that is indicates to the user that further help is availalble.

Note: I don't need the dialog to switch between text and long text.  In the issue, I was just suggesting that you provide multiple storybook examples - so we could see one example with short text, and another with long text.

I'd also like to see an example of an icon that has its own "more info" icon.

issues.title: Component for "More info available" text span
issues.body:
There are lots of occasions when we need to provide supporting/background information to a player (or even Game Designer in the admin pages).

We currently support this via tooltips, but it's cumbersome for a player to hover over all screen elements in the hope of finding tooltips.

I don't know if this is possible, but it would be great if we could have a modified span control that includes a small info marker (fa-circle-info) at the top-right.   Clicking on the question mark pops up the explanatory guidance.  I guess we should allow for up to 30 words.

I'm thinking of a span control since the text is currently just displayed as plain text - so switching to a `span` shouldn't cause any layout problems.

I guess the control would also have these props:
- icon color (so it can stand out from background)
- description text

We should develop this a StoryBook component that has a range of values for the above, including short and long descriptions.

Aah, hold on. There are also occasions when we wish to indicate that an icon has "more info" available.  So, I guess we also need an extended font-awesome icon that can have its own more-info icon at the top-right.

So, we'd be able to provide `more-info` for the `Password` and `Game control` column headers.
